adFormat.hook_ad.desc.en: Retired, replaced by the quick hook ad: one whole scene of the film, played as it is (15-60 s).
adFormat.hook_ad.desc.zh: 已停用，由快速钩子广告取代：整段原片场景，原样播放（15-60 秒）。

adFormat.narration_trailer.desc.en: The heroine narrates the plot in first person over the film, with one or two kept dialogue scenes.
adFormat.narration_trailer.desc.zh: 女主以第一人称讲述剧情，配原片画面，保留一两段原声对白。

adFormat.direct_cuts_trailer.desc.en: The same story spine as the narration trailer, carried by the characters' own lines, no narrator.
adFormat.direct_cuts_trailer.desc.zh: 与旁白预告相同的故事主线，全靠角色自己的台词推进，没有旁白。

adFormat.clip.desc.en: A window cut from one episode (what Studio's own cutter makes).
adFormat.clip.desc.zh: 从某一集里截取的一段（Studio 自动剪辑生成的就是这种）。

adFormat.quick_hook.desc.en: The most gripping 2-3 seconds of the story first, then the scene that leads up to it, cut before the payoff, with a line of text on screen.
adFormat.quick_hook.desc.zh: 先放剧情里最抓人的 2-3 秒，再接引出这一刻的那场戏，在揭晓前停住，画面上有一行字。
